name: Germany
summary: Germany is a federal republic in Western Europe and a member of both the European Union and the Schengen Area. German is the official language and the euro is the currency. Residence and work routes are published on the federal government's official portal for skilled immigration. No programme guides have been written for Germany yet, so this record carries only the facts that can be stated without research.
